title: 2021-22 Donruss #58 Malik Beasley Minnesota Timberwolves Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The NBA 2021-22 Donruss Malik Beasley #58 trading card features the Minnesota Timberwolves player as part of the modern set released by Donruss. This single sports trading card is an original, manufactured by Panini Group for basketball enthusiasts. With a focus on showcasing the talents of Malik Beasley during the 2021-22 season, this collectible item is a must-have for fans of the National Basketball Association.
